$Comment: The gameplay of zc's dungeon template: the game's Default_Instance (no world events) with no block placing, breaking or gathering, so nobody builds in a dungeon and every area pastes back clean for the next party; and a player who dies respawns at the world's spawn provider, which puts each player back in their own area. Default_Instance itself sends the dead out of the instance. A World group replaces the parent's whole group rather than adding to it, so all three block switches are written here. A dungeon whose template names another gameplay config keeps that one's rules.
